enum T_HID_CTL_POINT

Human Interface Device Service control point.

Values:

enumerator HID_SUSPEND

Informs APP that HID Host is entering the Suspend State.

enumerator HID_EXIT_SUSPEND

Informs APP that HID Host is exiting the Suspend State.

enum T_HID_PROTOCOL_MODE

Human Interface Device Service protocol mode.

Values:

enumerator BOOT_PROTOCOL_MODE

Boot Protocol Mode. A HID Service shall only enter Boot Protocol Mode after this value has been written.

enumerator REPORT_PROCOCOL_MODE

Report Protocol Mode. Default Protocol Mode of all HID Devices.
